# Fábio Magalhães — RevOps, Revenue Systems & AI Transformation Consultant · London

> Fractional RevOps (Revenue Operations) and AI transformation consultant helping B2B SaaS scale-ups build revenue systems: headless architecture, semantic layers, governance, custom MCP servers, and AI agents in production.

## Who I am
Fábio Magalhães is a fractional RevOps and AI transformation consultant working with VP Sales, CROs, and Founders at Series A–C B2B SaaS companies in the United Kingdom. Based in London.

## What I do
I rebuild the operating system behind scale-up revenue growth — revenue systems architecture, RevOps process design, and AI transformation. The record lives in one governed place; every team, tool, and AI agent consumes it through the same APIs (headless architecture).

Engagement models:
- **Free 1-Week AI Transformation Audit** — Bowtie stage diagnostic (CR1–CR8), CRM data quality review, AI-readiness roadmap, stack overlap analysis, and prioritised fix roadmap. No cost, no pitch.
- **Fractional RevOps / Revenue Systems Support** — Embedded fractional architect on a monthly retainer. I design, build, and operate your revenue operating system ongoing. No full-time hire required.
- **Full AI Transformation Programme** — Semantic layer, data governance, custom MCP servers, headless architecture, AI use-case portfolio. North-star metric: revenue per employee.

## Specialisms
- RevOps (Revenue Operations) and revenue systems architecture
- AI transformation for revenue teams: semantic layers, governance, AI agents in production
- Headless CRM / headless revenue architecture (decoupled system of record, API-first)
- Custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — exposing CRM, warehouse, and billing to AI agents securely
- Custom CRM / system-of-record builds (lean, API-first, AI-native)
- Salesforce and HubSpot architecture, governance, and cleanup
- Bowtie model diagnostics (CR1–CR8 customer lifecycle framework)
- AI sales automation (deal review agents, lead qualification, forecast agents, churn risk)
- Pipeline forecasting and revenue visibility
- Revenue stack integrations (Clay, Gong, ZoomInfo, BigQuery, Snowflake, n8n, MuleSoft)
- Revenue process discovery, documentation, and business analysis (BRDs, data dictionaries, ownership matrices)
